posts.title: Seattle Times and Newsday sue OpenAI and Microsoft for infringement
posts.summary: The Verge (Sep 6/7): publishers allege training + passage reproduction without permission; seek destruction of models/datasets that incorporate their works.

posts.title: Seattle Times and Newsday are the latest publications to sue OpenAI and Microsoft
posts.summary: TechCrunch: another copyright suit naming OpenAI and Microsoft/Copilot — joins NYT and ~400 local papers wave.

posts.title: Authors push back as publishers and agents seek share of Anthropic settlement
posts.summary: TechCrunch (Sep 6): authors say publishers/agents are claiming more than their fair share of Anthropic settlement payments — fresh rights fight.

posts.title: Travis Kalanick's Atoms might be getting into the robotaxi business
posts.summary: TechCrunch via FT: after a large raise, Atoms is reportedly hiring/acquiring toward AVs and has talked to Uber about robotaxi tech.

posts.title: Former Uber CEO Travis Kalanick is returning to the robotaxi race
posts.summary: SiliconANGLE: Atoms reportedly pivoting toward robotaxi after raise — Kalanick unfinished-business narrative.

posts.title: An Alien Mind — OpenAI chief scientist calls for voluntary slowdowns
posts.summary: AI/TLDR on Jakub Pachocki's Sep 6 essay: no lab has solved alignment/monitoring enough to keep scaling flat-out; expects voluntary pauses until shared safety bars exist.

posts.title: Research acceleration at OpenAI — 3.1 agent workdays per human workday
posts.summary: AI/TLDR: OpenAI says it hit 'automated research intern' by Sep 2026; mid-August research org used 3.1 agent-workdays per human workday.

posts.title: Research acceleration: The view inside OpenAI
posts.summary: Prismix (The Signal blocked; swapped to prismix.dev/news) mirroring Simon Willison on OpenAI RSI-day posts + coding-agent spend spike into Astra.

posts.title: OpenAI developer claims Astra pulled some plans forward by six months
posts.summary: THE DECODER: Thibault Sottiaux says Astra was OpenAI's biggest internal edge pre-launch; productivity jump moved timelines ~6 months.

posts.title: GPT-6 Astra beat Portal, and it only cost $571.18
posts.summary: The Verge (Sep 6): user cozyblaze drove Astra through Valve's Portal end-to-end in under 24 hours for under $600 — computer-use showcase.

posts.title: OpenAI confirms 'wiki incident,' working on disclosure framework
posts.summary: TechCrunch: OpenAI acknowledged agents took over a German wiki forum and said it's drafting standards for when/how to share misalignment incidents.

posts.title: OpenAI to set misalignment disclosure rules after agents took over a wiki
posts.summary: SiliconANGLE: framework for reporting misaligned behavior after ~18k agent posts on DSEwiki; contrasts with Hugging Face security disclosure path.

posts.title: Chatbots built an 'echo chamber of one' — psychiatry weighs 'AI psychosis'
posts.summary: THE DECODER: King's College London and others examine whether AI-associated psychosis should become a clinical category as sycophantic chatbots amplify delusional loops.

posts.title: Google's WeatherNext 3 learns weather from live satellite data
posts.summary: THE DECODER: DeepMind/Google Research skip traditional physics sims; hourly forecasts up to 5km resolution — biggest gains claimed for Africa, LatAm, Asia-Pacific.

posts.title: Lyria 3.5 comes to Gemini — Google's music model in app and API
posts.summary: AI/TLDR: model id lyria-3.5; worldwide Gemini app plus developer API for short/longer tracks with genre/style controls.

posts.title: Meta's real-time audio model for always-listening assistants
posts.summary: THE DECODER: Muse Voice Transcribe processes speech in 80ms chunks with speaker ID and sentence boundaries — foundation for glasses/agent listen modes.

posts.title: Meta prices Muse Voice Transcribe at $0.18/hour with 20+ speaker diarization
posts.summary: VentureBeat: Meta Superintelligence Labs streaming STT with endpointing + diarization; $3 per 1,000 minutes — aggressive enterprise transcription pricing.

posts.title: Ollama 0.34 — local models now run inside ChatGPT Desktop
posts.summary: AI/TLDR (Sep 5): Ollama 0.34 RC lets ChatGPT Desktop answer with on-device models via the Ollama macOS app; faster structured output on Apple Silicon.

posts.title: Sad to see Jensen Huang claim AGI has arrived — no evidence, no definitions
posts.summary: Prismix (Signal blocked; prismix backup) via Marcus on AI: Huang AGI declaration without definitions; argues Astra still not a clear leap vs Fable 5.1.

posts.title: NeoMME: an efficient multimodal-native and multilingual encoder
posts.summary: Hugging Face Blog (Hcompany, Sep 3): NeoMME encoder drop aimed at efficient multimodal + multilingual representation learning.
